verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's docs describe stale-flag detection: it can automatically detect stale flags so you can clean them up. That covers the 'find stale flags' half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows code-reference scanning or any link from flags to their locations in the codebase. Missing for 10: code references / repository scanning to locate flag usages, detail on how staleness is determined, independent or hands-on corroboration of stale detection.
